stories.title: House Democrats pick Hakeem Jeffries to be the first Black Speaker
stories.dek: Jeffries won the caucus nomination 251-11 in a closed-door vote Nov. 18, TheGrio reports. The full House elects its Speaker after the new Congress is sworn in Jan. 3, 2027.

stories.title: The Jackson creator behind Scott Colom's viral Senate ads
stories.dek: Ryan Sayles, 27, had never worked a campaign before filming Colom's protein ad, which passed 16 million views per Yahoo News. Colom has credited him; Sayles calls it a team effort, Capital B reports.

stories.title: The Emanuel Nine Memorial opens beside Mother Emanuel in Charleston
stories.dek: Designed by 9/11 memorial architect Michael Arad, it centers on a Fountain of Grace ringed by the victims' names. The foundation has raised about $19.9 million of its $25 million goal, Capital B reports.

stories.title: NYPD disbands the protest unit criticized over BLM marches
stories.dek: Mayor Mamdani is replacing the Strategic Response Group with a civilian-led de-escalation division and banning kettling and tear gas at protests, Word In Black reports.

stories.title: BET president Louis Carr will leave the network after 40 years
stories.dek: His last day is Dec. 31. Carr, who led media sales for 25 years before becoming president, said in a memo he chose to chart a new path. No successor is named yet, AfroTech reports.

stories.title: Squire co-founder says an investor told him to hire non-Black executives
stories.dek: Dave Salvant shared the account at the AfroTech Conference. The barbershop software company was valued at $750 million in 2021, per a company release cited by Black Enterprise.

stories.title: King's handwritten 'I Have a Dream' draft goes on view in Atlanta
stories.dek: The final draft is at the National Center for Civil and Human Rights before a Jan. 22 Christie's sale expected near $10 million, benefiting the King Center, TheGrio reports.

stories.alt: Brooklynn Fields and Lena Waithe sit side by side in an empty, purple-lit movie theater
stories.title: Lena Waithe's reading series spotlights Black masc-of-center writer Brooklynn Fields
stories.dek: Waithe's monthly Around the Table series stages the LET OUT, a feature script co-written by Fields, free in Los Angeles on Nov. 19, GAYE Magazine reports.

stories.title: Supreme Court leaves California's implicit bias training for doctors in place
stories.dek: The justices declined a challenge from Do No Harm and an ophthalmologist, keeping rulings that upheld the 2019 law. Thomas, Alito and Gorsuch wanted to hear it, TheGrio reports.

stories.title: NAACP report warns AI could widen health gaps for Black patients
stories.dek: The NAACP and Sanofi report, drawn from nearly 23,000 community members, says about 3.8 million Black Americans lack home broadband and a third of Black adults expect AI to worsen bias in care.

stories.title: Floyd Norman, Disney's first Black animator, receives an honorary Oscar
stories.dek: Mahershala Ali presented the award to the 91-year-old at the Nov. 15 Governors Awards. Norman joined Disney in 1956 and worked on The Jungle Book, TheGrio reports.

stories.title: MOBO founder Kanya King honored with a stone at her childhood school
stories.dek: A MOBO Paving the Way stone was unveiled at Queens Park Community School in London, 30 years after the first MOBO Awards, with Emeli Sandé attending, That Grape Juice reports.

stories.title: Baltimore teens sue after an AI system mistook chips for a gun
stories.dek: Four students were handcuffed at Kenwood High in 2025 after an Omnilert alert. The suit names the company, the school district and police, TheGrio reports. The claims are unproven.

stories.title: Serena Williams launches Starfire Ventures to back AI-era startups
stories.dek: Williams and Beth Ferreira's new New York firm seeks $200 million for seed to Series A tech and AI-native companies, AfroTech reports. Serena Ventures raised $111 million in 2022.

stories.title: Hacker tied to the 2022 GTA VI leak admits Rockstar breach
stories.dek: Arion Kurtaj, 21, admitted the hack and others with the Lapsus$ group, GamesRadar+ reports, citing the BBC. Rockstar says recovery cost $5 million. GTA VI launches Nov. 19.

stories.title: Most women gamers surveyed plan to play GTA VI within a month of launch
stories.dek: In a Censuswide poll of 2,523 U.S. women gamers for ACE.com, 59% said they expect to play within a month of the Nov. 19 release. The survey measures plans, not sales.
stories.alt: Grand Theft Auto VI promotional artwork of a woman in a green cropped jersey by a resort pool

stories.title: Travis Scott-linked firm drops its claim to the Houston Comets name
stories.dek: TSTM Holdings withdrew its trademark application Oct. 29, clearing a hurdle for the WNBA team moving to Houston for 2027, TheGrio reports. Why it withdrew has not been disclosed.

stories.title: Veronica Burton reflects on the Valkyries' first WNBA title
stories.dek: The Most Improved Player won a championship after Game 7 on Halloween, then joined a parade of an estimated 400,000 fans in San Francisco, Andscape reports.

stories.title: Teyana Taylor graduates from culinary school
stories.dek: The Golden Globe winner finished at the Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts on Nov. 15 and called the experience therapeutic, TheGrio reports.

stories.title: The Melanie Dolls land on H-E-B shelves in Houston
stories.dek: Founder Datreese Thomas, 27, says H-E-B told her it's the retailer's first direct-delivery vendor selling Black dolls. She is seeking $5 million to expand, AfroTech reports.

stories.title: UMES supporters sue Maryland for $6 billion over HBCU underfunding
stories.dek: ForUMES and students allege the state has shortchanged the HBCU land-grant school since 1890. Gov. Moore's office won't discuss the case but says it will keep investing in UMES, AfroTech reports.

stories.title: Morehouse student arrested as campus sexual violence concerns grow
stories.dek: President F. DuBois Bowman said campus police arrested a student Nov. 13 after an alleged off-campus assault. It is unclear if it ties to a Spelman student's October report, Capital B reports.

stories.title: Tennessee State builds the only HBCU mining engineering program
stories.dek: TSU's minor, funded by an $800,000 Energy Department grant, has about 15 students and could become a major, US Black Engineer reports.

stories.title: Ohio State's James L. Moore III elected to two national academies
stories.dek: The former NSF engineering program director joined the National Academy of Education and the Academy of Public Administration, US Black Engineer reports.

stories.title: Kid Cudi will release a dance album as RAGER on Dec. 10
stories.dek: Cudi announced Visions in the Night on social media, with artwork due Nov. 30 and the tracklist Dec. 7. Collaborators and track count are not yet known, That Grape Juice reports.

stories.title: Grammy nominations: Beyoncé reaches 100 as Leon Thomas earns six
stories.dek: Raye leads with 11 nods. Yung Miami got her first and Tems is up for Best R&B Solo Performance. The ceremony airs Feb. 7 on ABC, BlackPressUSA reports.

stories.title: Black family wealth fell 25% as U.S. wealth rose, Fed survey shows
stories.dek: Median Black family net worth dropped from $49,100 to $36,800 between 2022 and 2025, the only group to fall, per the Federal Reserve survey, The Community Voice reports.

stories.title: Georgia's first Black insurance commissioner targets ZIP code pricing
stories.dek: Commissioner-elect Keisha Sean Waites wants to ban auto rates based on credit scores or ZIP codes and says the industry is already pushing back, Capital B Atlanta reports.

stories.alt: A still from 14th: two women talk across a desk in a wood-paneled office beside an American flag
stories.title: Ava DuVernay's 14th, her follow-up to 13th, opens Nov. 27
stories.dek: The documentary traces more than 150 years of the 14th Amendment through 50-plus interviews. It hits select theaters Nov. 27 and Netflix Dec. 4 after closing the New York Film Festival.

stories.alt: Keke Palmer smiles and holds up a purple Apple Podcasts icon against a pink-to-purple background
stories.title: Keke Palmer's podcast is Apple's 2026 Show of the Year
stories.dek: Apple Podcasts named Baby, This Is Keke Palmer, her Wondery interview show, its 2026 Show of the Year, citing its mix of celebrity talk and life topics. Guests have included Oprah Winfrey.

stories.title: Martine Rose takes over Balenciaga as its first woman creative director
stories.dek: Kering named the British-Jamaican designer to lead all of Balenciaga's design starting Nov. 16. Black Enterprise calls her the second Black woman to head a major European luxury house.

stories.title: Tyra Banks says Beverly Johnson once offered her a room in her home
stories.dek: On HOT 97, Banks said the pioneering Black supermodel offered her a free place to stay early in her career so she would be looked after in a tough industry, TheGrio reports.

stories.title: Druski becomes the first digital creator to host SNL
stories.dek: The comedian hosted the Nov. 7 episode with The Strokes as musical guest. TheGrio reports he is the first digital content creator to host in the show's 52 seasons; Dave Chappelle and Chris Rock dropped in.

stories.title: Janelle James takes her first hourlong special to Netflix
stories.dek: The Abbott Elementary star taped How Romantic at Chicago's Vic Theatre, close to where she started doing stand-up in Champaign, WBEZ reports. She hosts the Critics Choice Awards in January.

stories.title: Kenyatta, Torres and Scott among Black LGBTQ winners in the midterms
stories.dek: Gaye Magazine's roundup lists a fifth term for Pennsylvania Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta, a fourth for U.S. Rep. Ritchie Torres, both described as gay, and Jaelynn Scott's Washington House win.

stories.title: Former PragerU host Xaviaer DuRousseau sues, alleging racism and anti-gay abuse
stories.dek: LGBTQ Nation reports the Black gay conservative influencer filed in California Superior Court, claiming discrimination, retaliation and wrongful termination. PragerU denies the allegations.

stories.title: Black trans women were half of known violent deaths in a new remembrance report
stories.dek: Advocates for Trans Equality's report, released before the Nov. 20 Trans Day of Remembrance, honors 62 trans people who died over the past year, 28 of them killed. A4TE says the count is likely incomplete.

stories.title: E. Lynn Harris musical Behind the Mask comes to the Howard Theatre
stories.dek: Based on Harris's novels of Black gay love, the show runs Nov. 30 and Dec. 1 around World AIDS Day, with songs by Ashford and Simpson, The Washington Informer reports.

stories.title: Cynthia Erivo will play Afeni Shakur in Universal's Snoop Dogg biopic
stories.dek: Universal announced the casting Nov. 4. Erivo, who is openly bisexual, plays Tupac Shakur's mother, a Black Panther and organizer. Craig Brewer directs Snoop, due in theaters Aug. 6, 2027.

regional.title: Ivy City residents keep up their fight against a sealant plant
regional.dek: Empower D.C. and neighbors cite odors and health fears at NEPI. City and EPA tests in 2023 and 2024 found no notable health effect, and the owner defends the plant, The Washington Informer reports.

regional.title: D.C.'s O Museum in the Mansion marks 47 years
regional.dek: A Nov. 10 gala honored the museum, where Rosa Parks stayed on and off for nearly a decade, and its founder's 76th birthday, with go-go band Sirius Company, The Washington Informer reports.

regional.title: Three new grocery stores take aim at Birmingham-area food deserts
regional.dek: We All Eat Market, Carver Jones Market and Gary Avenue Market opened this year in Birmingham and Fairfield, where about 70% of city residents live in a food desert, The Birmingham Times reports.

regional.title: Retired EY executive will steer St. Augustine's bankruptcy
regional.dek: A judge approved Malcomb Coley as chief restructuring officer for the Raleigh HBCU, which lost accreditation in 2025, and set a Jan. 8 plan deadline, The Charlotte Post reports.

regional.title: Gary releases its derecho report and plans warning sirens
regional.dek: The 238-page review of the Aug. 11 storm adds an emergency manager and 10 sirens, and the city asked NIPSCO for a disconnection pause, Capital B Gary reports.

regional.title: Nikole Hannah-Jones talks history and power at WashU
regional.dek: Speaking at Graham Chapel in a Black studies lecture series, she discussed the rollback of affirmative action and diversity programs and her work on The 1619 Project, The St. Louis American reports.

regional.title: Houston ISD's elected board could return by mid-January
regional.dek: The state-appointed board says trustees could be ready by mid-January 2027, ending a takeover that began in 2023; TEA has not set a formal end date, the Houston Defender reports.

regional.title: Fifth Ward still waits on an EPA cancer cluster report
regional.dek: Residents say the agency has held a risk evaluation of a rail yard site since October 2025. Rep. Christian Menefee wants it released by Dec. 1, the Houston Defender reports.

regional.title: Oakland extends its AI data center moratorium to 2027
regional.dek: The council voted unanimously to keep the pause until Oct. 5, 2027. Councilmember Carroll Fife cited pollution, noise and water use, Post News Group reports.

regional.title: Tukwila's Youth and Law Forum returns for its 36th year
regional.dek: The Judge Charles V. Johnson forum covers police encounters, bullying, mental health and online safety, with Erin Jones and Shawn Kemp, The Seattle Medium reports.

weekly.title: House Democrats pick Hakeem Jeffries to be the first Black Speaker
weekly.dek: Jeffries won the caucus nomination 251-11 in a closed-door vote Nov. 18, TheGrio reports. The full House elects its Speaker after the new Congress is sworn in Jan. 3, 2027.

weekly.title: The Emanuel Nine Memorial opens beside Mother Emanuel in Charleston
weekly.dek: Designed by 9/11 memorial architect Michael Arad, it centers on a Fountain of Grace ringed by the victims' names. The foundation has raised about $19.9 million of its $25 million goal, Capital B reports.

weekly.title: Grammy nominations: Beyoncé reaches 100 as Leon Thomas earns six
weekly.dek: Raye leads with 11 nods. Yung Miami got her first and Tems is up for Best R&B Solo Performance. The ceremony airs Feb. 7 on ABC, BlackPressUSA reports.

weekly.title: Black family wealth fell 25% as U.S. wealth rose, Fed survey shows
weekly.dek: Median Black family net worth dropped from $49,100 to $36,800 between 2022 and 2025, the only group to fall, per the Federal Reserve survey, The Community Voice reports.

monthly.title: Jaelynn Scott wins a Washington House seat, a first for Black trans women
monthly.dek: Scott took about 87% of the vote in Seattle's 37th District. Gaye Magazine reports she is the first openly Black transgender woman elected to a state legislature.

monthly.title: Charleston opens a memorial to the Emanuel Nine at Mother Emanuel
monthly.dek: The 6,000-square-foot stone memorial beside the church opens Nov. 14 with a 9 a.m. public ceremony. TheGrio reports it cost $20 million, funded mostly by donations.

monthly.title: Valkyries-Dream Finals draws the WNBA's biggest audience since 1999
monthly.dek: The seven-game series against the Atlanta Dream averaged 1.88 million viewers, up 30% from 2025, the league says. Game 7 drew 3.3 million, a record for a WNBA playoff game.
